verdict.rationale: Zoom publishes a structured, OpenAPI-backed AI Services API reference covering the Scribe operations, and a machine-readable spec is served live. Separately, there is an interactive console where users can record speech, use a sample conversation, upload a file, or enter a URL to try transcription. Neither piece is shown to be an interactive reference with in-page runnable request examples, so support is only partial. missing for 10: evidence of 'try it'/runnable request execution inside the API reference itself, code samples tied to each endpoint, independent or hands-on corroboration of the interactive experience.
